explanation_short: SHAP importance plot for the best KNN model.  The top features are VFA, Butyrate, and Acetate.
explanation_full: This chart shows the SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) values for the top features influencing the performance of the best KNN model. The higher the value, the more important the feature is in predicting the outcome.  The plot reveals that VFA, Butyrate, and Acetate are the most influential features, followed by VSS, Propionate, Ethanol, COD-O, pH, ORP_Low, ORP_Mid, and Sucrose_Degradation. This information can be used to understand which factors are most critical for predicting the target variable in this specific dataset.  The chart also provides a visual representation of feature contributions, allowing for easier interpretation compared to raw numerical values alone.
